issues.issue: Local-source categorical grant. The General Fund spends a similar amount on '3400 Categorical Grants From Corporations/Private Interests' (211,631, p7), so donations/contributions (or a Categorical Grants category, as ruled for Lincoln Public Schools code 1925) may fit better than other. The printed label does say 'Other', so this is left as a warning.

issues.on_page: Employee Benefit Fund: Other Support Services 88,322
issues.issue: The printed label is a support-services line, but it is categorized Instruction (following the statement's Instruction total), while the Depreciation Fund's 'Central Services - Other Support Services' 220,209 (detail[74], also counted under Instruction on the statement) is categorized Business. The two are treated inconsistently.
